Class SparkWrapper

java.lang.Object
yams.core.motorcontrollers.SmartMotorController
yams.core.motorcontrollers.local.SparkWrapper
public class SparkWrapper extends SmartMotorController
Spark wrapper for REV Spark Motor controllers.

External encoder discontinuity point support (SparkAbsoluteEncoder):

  • 0.5 rotations sensor range is [-0.5, 0.5), zeroCentered = true
  • 1.0 rotations sensor range is [0, 1), zeroCentered = false
A discontinuity point must be configured via SmartMotorControllerConfig.withExternalEncoderDiscontinuityPoint(Angle) whenever a SparkAbsoluteEncoder is used as the external encoder.

Example

// Configure and create a SPARK MAX (NEO motor) on CAN ID 3
SmartMotorControllerConfig config = new SmartMotorControllerConfig()
    .withMotorInverted(false)
    .withStatorCurrentLimit(Amps.of(40))
    .withClosedLoopController(0.2,0,0)
    .withExternalEncoderDiscontinuityPoint(Rotations.of(0.5)); // required for
SparkAbsoluteEncoder SmartMotorController motor = new SparkWrapper( new SparkMax(3,
MotorType.kBrushless), DCMotor.getNEO(1), config); Arm arm = new Arm(new
ArmConfig(motor).withLength(Meters.of(0.6)));

  • Constructor Details

    • SparkWrapper

      public SparkWrapper(SparkBase controller, org.wpilib.math.system.DCMotor motor, SmartMotorControllerConfig<?> config)
      Create a SmartMotorController from SparkMax or SparkFlex
      Parameters:
      controller - SparkMax or SparkFlex
      motor - DCMotor controller by the SparkFlex or SparkMax. Must be a brushless motor.
      config - SmartMotorControllerConfig to apply.
      Throws:
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if the vendor config does not match the controller type (a SparkMaxConfig is required for a SparkMax and a SparkFlexConfig for a SparkFlex).
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if the motor is a NEO 550 with no stator current limit.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if the motor is a NEO 550 with a stator current limit above 40A.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if applyConfig(SmartMotorControllerConfig) rejects the config.
      IllegalArgumentException - if the controller is neither a SparkMax nor a SparkFlex.
      IllegalArgumentException - if applyConfig(SmartMotorControllerConfig) rejects the config.

    • setVelocity

      public void setVelocity(org.wpilib.units.measure.AngularVelocity angularVelocity, org.wpilib.units.measure.Force feedforwardForce)
      Set the Mechanism AngularVelocity using the PID and feedforward from SmartMotorControllerConfig, with an additional feedforward Force applied on top, e.g. from a PathPlanner set-point generator. Applied whether the motor controller's native closed-loop velocity control or an LQR/software motion profile loop is driving the mechanism.
      Specified by:
      setVelocity in class SmartMotorController
      Parameters:
      angularVelocity - Mechanism AngularVelocity to target.
      feedforwardForce - Additional feedforward Force applied to the mechanism, or null for none.
      Throws:
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if a feedforward force is given without an LQR controller and the mechanism circumference is not configured.

      public boolean applyConfig(SmartMotorControllerConfig<?> config)
      Apply the SmartMotorControllerConfig to the SmartMotorController.
      Specified by:
      applyConfig in class SmartMotorController
      Parameters:
      config - SmartMotorControllerConfig to use.
      Returns:
      Successful Application of the configuration.
      Throws:
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if a supply current limit is configured.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if an external encoder discontinuity point is configured without an external encoder.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if an external encoder zero offset is configured without an external encoder.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if an external encoder inversion is configured without an external encoder.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if an external encoder gearing is configured without an external encoder.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if a closed loop control period is configured without an exponential profile or LQR controller.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if a closed loop controller maximum voltage is configured without an exponential profile or LQR controller.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if a feedback synchronization threshold is configured without an exponential profile or LQR controller.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if a temperature cutoff is configured without an exponential or trapezoidal profile.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if a vendor control request is configured.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if the continuous wrapping bounds do not span exactly one rotation.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if a linear closed loop controller is in use without a mechanism circumference.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if a required config option is left unhandled during validation.
      IllegalArgumentException - if a closed loop control period is configured with an exponential profile or LQR controller while not in closed loop mode.
      IllegalArgumentException - if a closed loop tolerance is configured with an LQR controller.
      IllegalArgumentException - if the external encoder is not a SparkAbsoluteEncoder.
      IllegalArgumentException - if a follower is not a SparkMax or SparkFlex.
      IllegalArgumentException - if relative encoder inversion is configured.
